full_details: Fair Em was at the Cross Keys at two. You were not in it. The Rose billed French Doctor. You did not go. There is no rehearsal until nine tomorrow. At dinner you ate Friday fish at Mistress Ansell's board, threepence, and the loaf was still a finger short. At eight, by one candle, you fair-copied a sonnet on a single leaf. No title, no number, and no name on it or anywhere near it. The first line is the one you know by heart for a tired man. You read it over and changed nothing. You laid it in the folder with two older leaves. You did not read it aloud. You were in bed by ten. About two you were awake for a while, and you did not start another poem.
one_sentence: You stayed in all day, and by one candle you fair-copied a sonnet onto a leaf.
title: One candle, and a third leaf
